proposals.evidence: Turner *jvālana explicitly gives Hindi jāran firewood and Bhojpuri jāran. The eastern Nepal-survey jarna/jārnā forms fit this kindling/fuel family with local vowel syncope and final-vowel variation. The distinct jvalana burning/inflammation noun and aspirated jhar- forms are not merged here.
